meta.title: Session Editing
meta.description: dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed loop on RDB persistence; the conversation shell stays on the official ui-conversation row and our extensions only register on its slots.
